dataList.desc: ได้รับตัวตน
dataList.dlg: หอกข้าต่างหากที่เสียบทะลุคอเจ้าศัตรูตนนั้นในตอนท้าย! เห็นชัด ๆ เลยมิใช่รึว่าแต้มสังหารนั่นนับเป็นของข้าน่ะ? แบบนี้เจ้าก็ได้ไปสองนะ พ่อหนุ่มน้อยซินแคลร์ แบบนี้ยุติธรรมดีแล้ว ตรรกะอะไรของคุณกันน่ะครับ? เรา ทั้งคู่ ทิ่มทะลุเจ้านั่นด้วยกันนะ แบบนี้ก็แปลว่าเราได้กันคนละสองจุดห้าแต้มสิ ให้ตายสิ นี่คุณพูดออกมาหน้าตาเฉยแบบนั้นได้ไงกันนะ?

Young Sinclair!! Come thee to the cupboard...! Prithee, fetch down the cereal...! Who saw fit to place it at such a lofty height?!
<color=#8b9c15>... I did. When I used to be able to reach it. Now I can't.</color>
W-well, that's...
<color=#8b9c15>You know, if you'd actually bothered to read the fine print on the insurance, I wouldn't have been stuck like this...</color>

"Tangsuyuk". "Yukgaejang"! "Jambon-beurre". Re... "Reblochon on potato gratin"! Ugh... Tang... "Tangbao"...? O... "Omurice"! What sayest thou to that? Heh. "Smørrebrød". Ehhhh?! "Ble"? "Bro"? What manner of food is that?! It's an open-faced sandwich. All right, then. Guess you're buying lunch today. *groan* Very well. I shall fetch some omurice... to go.

Nnngh...! *huff* *huff* Every evening... 'tis the same nightmare—those wretches tearing young Sinclair limb from limb, again and again...
<color=#8b9c15>...? Did you call me?</color>
Ah, n-nay! 'Tis nothing, nothing at all!

<color=#8b9c15>... Don Quixote, please tell me you haven't forgotten the upcoming insurance renewal.</color>
Hm?! N-nay, of course not...!
<color=#8b9c15>... And go over the add-ons. I swear, if you forget to get the clone body's growth shots covered again, I'm gonna... *sigh*</color>
'Twas my fault, forsooth... Have I not admitted my guilt often enough...?

Ugh... You know, you're getting insufferable. Nobody said you were wrong or anything. Verily, we ought to give him some space, young Sinclair... He hath yet to recover... No, enough is enough. All we said was we'll work together on this one job 'cause Fixers who think like you aren't a good fit for our Office, simple as that. And you had to be a miserable ass about it out of the blue! Could you please... never mind. Look, you little—stop frowning already, would you?

A wedge, thou seest, is a weapon most divorced from cleaving and crushing. Behold the pinpoint-keen tip of this spear mine: dost thou see?! 'Tis a weapon of unparalleled efficiency! A strike most singular and focus most fine requireth little strength to execute. Such is the work befitting a "Wedge!" Consequently! Those who seek our Office with a quest in their bosom expect no brute strength, nay; 'tis swiftness and precision... founded upon the bedrock of shrewd and precise situational assessment! Heh heh, that is what our Office is!

<color=#8b9c15>Not exactly the kind of situation where we can afford to be polite. I'll get to skewering you right away.</color>
As a Fixer, I can scarce afford proper etiquette when lives stand at stake! Surely thou canst understand!

<color=#8b9c15>Our Office has particularly low tolerance for dickheads who like to dress themselves up as "selfless." Doubly so when the most selfish of them don't seem to realize that himself.</color>

<color=#8b9c15>... How long is that punk going to leech on our Office?</color>
Prithee, practice patience! Thou recallest Lady Outis's reassurance, dost thou not? He shall depart anon following this contract's completion.

<color=#8b9c15>Hey, don't glare at us now. We just poked you to make sure.</color>
Heh heh, I had heard that thou wert supposed to be "nice"—I expect naught else but the maximum generosity from thee!
Prithee, young Sinclair! Stay clear of position mine!
I shall clear the way forth!
ตัวข้านั้นเพ่งสนใจอีกฝ่ายอยู่ โปรดไปปรึกษากับท่านซินแคลร์หากมีเรื่องด่วนอะไร!
เจาะทะลุ!
ราวกับหนังสือแหน่ะ!
เห้อ... เหนื่อยจริง ๆ เลย
โอ้! ก็มิได้ยากอะไรขนาดนั้น!
เป็นความผิดพลาด... อันร้ายแรงจริง ๆ ...
Hoyday! Perchance thou hast forgotten someone to credit for thine success? I daresay the first half was made possible only thanks to my—!!
Have I not warned thee, that thine approach was misguid—

Phew... That be one quest behind us! What sayest thou, young Sinclair, to a moment's respite?
<color=#8b9c15>We still have some headaches to deal with, but... Eh, it's whatever at this point, right?</color>

dataList.desc: เงื่อนไข EX ผ่าน
dataList.dlg:
<color=#8b9c15>พวกนั้นสร้างปัญหาให้เราอยู่บ้าง แต่ก็—</color>
—แต่ก็เห็นอยู่ทนโท่ ครั้นรับมาแล้ว ก็ไม่มีสัญญาใดที่เรามิอาจพิชิต!
<color=#8b9c15>ครับ แถมสัญญานี้ก็ยัง—</color>
—ถูกจัดการแบบสุดลิ่มทิ่มประตู!
<color=#8b9c15>โอ้ยยยยยย!!!!! เชี่ยเอ๊ย หยุดเข้ามาขัดผมสักวิมันจะตายรึไงวะครับ?!</color>

<color=#8b9c15>Damn punk... I knew he'd hightail it the moment shit hit the fan...</color>
Alas... 'twas an expected outcome, was it not...?
<color=#8b9c15>Tsk, don't talk...! You're gonna lose more blood than insurance's willing to cover...</color>
